payload.claim: The guard prefix `f"{review.HOST_FILED}{criterion.witness} stayed green with "` is a hand-rebuilt copy of the literal text that `survivor_finding` writes in `saffron/phases/review.py:687` and `:693`. No shared constant or helper produces this string in one place; `_guarded_blockers`'s docstring even says the match "follows from `survivor_finding`" as a documented convention rather than an enforced one. A future wording edit to either of `survivor_finding`'s two claim templates (e.g. rephrasing "stayed green with") silently stops the guard from recognizing a host-filed blocker, and no gate — only these specific tests, if run — would catch it. This is a restated value, not an imported one, which the standing conventions call out even when the two copies agree today.
